description: Commit 21 — Hospital dashboard overview with real stat cards and a paginated request list at /dashboard/hospital/requests. Adds the hospital-side authenticated API layer in src/lib/hospitals.ts, URL-based filters, nav items, and replaces the placeholder 'coming soon' card on the overview page.
steps: 1. Edit src/lib/hospitals.ts: add `hospitalRequestApi` object with methods: `myRequests(token, query: RequestBoardQuery)` → `apiPaginated<BloodRequest[]>('/hospitals/me/requests', { token, cache: 'no-store', query })`, `requestById(token, id)` → `api<BloodRequestDetail>('/hospitals/me/requests/' + id, { token, cache: 'no-store' })`, `createRequest(token, body: CreateBloodRequestInput)` → `api<BloodRequest>('/hospitals/me/requests', { method: 'POST', token, cache: 'no-store', body })`, `fulfillRequest(token, requestId)` → `api<BloodRequest>('/hospitals/me/requests/' + requestId + '/fulfill', { method: 'PATCH', token, cache: 'no-store' })`. Import `apiPaginated`, `BloodRequest`, `BloodRequestDetail`, `CreateBloodRequestInput`, `RequestBoardQuery` from their respective modules.

2. Edit src/components/dashboard/nav-config.ts: add three nav items to HOSPITAL array: `{ href: '/dashboard/hospital/requests', label: 'Requests', icon: Droplets }`, `{ href: '/dashboard/hospital/requests/new', label: 'New request', icon: Plus }`, `{ href: '/dashboard/hospital/profile', label: 'Hospital profile', icon: Building2 }`. Add `Droplets, Plus` to the lucide-react import.

3. Edit src/app/dashboard/hospital/page.tsx: after fetching `hospital`, also call `hospitalRequestApi.myRequests(session.accessToken, { limit: 5, sortBy: 'createdAt', sortOrder: 'desc' })` to get recent requests (catch → empty). Replace the placeholder 'Blood requests' card with: (a) a 3-column stats grid showing Total Requests / Open / Fulfilled counts using the same rounded-[24px] border border-ink/10 bg-cream p-6 card pattern as donor/page.tsx; (b) a 'Recent requests' section listing up to 5 `<RequestCard>` items with a 'See all requests' link to /dashboard/hospital/requests; (c) a 'New request' ButtonLink pointing to /dashboard/hospital/requests/new. Import `RequestCard` from `src/components/request/request-card.tsx`, `ButtonLink` from `src/components/ui/button.tsx`, `hospitalRequestApi` from `src/lib/hospitals.ts`.

4. Create src/app/dashboard/hospital/requests/page.tsx: async Server Component. Read `searchParams`, call `parseBoardParams(await searchParams)` from `src/lib/requests.ts`, fetch `hospitalRequestApi.myRequests(session.accessToken, parsedQuery)`. Render: eyebrow 'My requests' + h1, a `<HospitalFilters />` (Suspense wrapper), paginated list of `<RequestCard>` items (or empty state), and pagination prev/next links using `boardHref` from `src/lib/requests.ts`. Add metadata `{ title: 'My requests' }`.
5. Create src/app/dashboard/hospital/requests/loading.tsx: export default Loading() returning a div with LoadingLabel + 5× RequestCardSkeleton.

6. Create src/app/dashboard/hospital/requests/components/hospital-filters.tsx: 'use client'. Copy the structure of src/components/request/filters.tsx but remove the 'canHelp' / 'bloodGroup' donor-specific selects and 'sortBy'. Keep: search input (hospital or location), status tabs (Pending / Open / Matched / Fulfilled / All mapped to PENDING/VERIFIED/MATCHED/FULFILLED/all), urgency chips, clear-all button. All state lives in URL via router.replace. Export `HospitalFilters`.

7. Commit: `git add src/lib/hospitals.ts src/components/dashboard/nav-config.ts src/app/dashboard/hospital/page.tsx src/app/dashboard/hospital/requests/` && `git commit -m 'feat: add hospital dashboard and request list'`

npm run lint exits 0 — no ESLint errors
src/app/dashboard/hospital/requests/page.tsx exists and is a valid async Server Component
nav-config.ts HOSPITAL array has 4 items (Overview + Requests + New request + Hospital profile)
hospitalRequestApi is exported from src/lib/hospitals.ts with myRequests, requestById, createRequest, fulfillRequest methods
findings: 1. BloodRequest → PublicRequest adapter: `hospitalRequestApi.myRequests` returns `BloodRequest[]` (with `requester.hospital`), but `RequestCard` expects `PublicRequest` (with `hospital` directly). A `toPublicRequest()` helper (local to each consuming page) maps `requester.hospital` → `hospital`. FEAT-002/003/004 coders must use this same adapter wherever `RequestCard` is used with `BloodRequest` data. 2. RequestBoardQuery.status extended: added `'pending'` to the `status` union in `src/types/index.ts` and to `BOARD_STATUSES` in `src/lib/requests.ts` so the hospital Pending filter tab can be passed through `parseBoardParams`. The public request board and donor boards are unaffected. 3. HospitalFilters default tab: defaults to 'all' (not 'open') since hospitals want to see all their own requests by default. 4. boardHref base path: `boardHref()` hardcodes `/requests` — the hospital requests page uses a local `hospitalBoardHref()` wrapper that replaces the base with `/dashboard/hospital/requests`. FEAT-002+ should follow the same pattern if they need pagination. 5. PageProps for new routes: used explicit `{ searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>> }` type instead of `PageProps<'...'>` because the new routes are not yet in routes.d.ts at the time of authoring (Next.js regenerates routes.d.ts on build). After the first build, the routes are available and `PageProps<'/dashboard/hospital/requests'>` etc. can be used.
